remarks: Directly across from Bruce Park, this three bedroom townhouse has a private back yard and great space. The first floor living room with fireplace and dining area extend to a large deck overlooking the yard. The kitchen has ample cupboard storage and room for an eatin area . There is an attached garage off the front hallway, and also a powder room Upstairs a large primary suite with vaulted ceiling and skylight includes a large walk in closet and ensuite bath. Two secondary bedrooms share a hall bath. The lower level has a generously-sized family room with fireplace and windows to the back. There is a lot of storage on this level as well. Seconds from downtown, Island Beach Ferry, Train and the Bruce Museum. Downtown living without the traffic!
